idea: An engraved acrylic sign with my club's name for our tabling booth, about 12 inches wide. We need one.

ask.summary: You want to make an engraved acrylic sign for your club's tabling booth.

needs.why: To cut and engrave the acrylic sheet.

steps.title: Design the sign
steps.detail: Draw your club name in design software for the laser cutter (cuts flat sheets very precisely).

steps.title: Prepare the machine
steps.detail: Place the acrylic sheet inside the laser cutter and focus the beam.

steps.title: Run the job
steps.detail: Start the machine to engrave your text and cut out the sign.

routes.process: Laser cut and engrave an acrylic sheet.

warnings.fix: Wait for the lid to unlock before opening.

routes.fit_reason: The Baum Family Maker Space has a laser cutter that cuts and etches acrylic cleanly.

raw_model_output.summary: An engraved acrylic sign for a club tabling booth.

computed_plan.summary: An engraved acrylic sign for a club tabling booth.

eligibility.note: The Maker Space says it is for Viterbi undergraduates. Confirm at the front desk.

first_visit: Go to Baum Family Maker Space, Ground floor, Science and Engineering Library. Listed hours: Monday to Friday 11 AM to 10 PM; Saturday 10 AM to 5 PM.
Take the Level 1 orientation and safety training. It lets you use the non-powered hand tools.
Take the training level for the tools you need: Level 2 for hand tools and handheld drills, Level 3 for power tools, Level 4 for electronics.

warnings.fix: Use a bold font for your club name.

routes.fit_reason: The laser cutter handles acrylic sheets easily and creates clean engraved text.
